# manifold_governance_policies (Data Source)

Lists governance policies, both customer-authored and Manifold-managed. Filters combine with AND; values within one filter combine with OR. List items omit `cedar_policy`; read it with `manifold_governance_policy`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "manifold_governance_policies" "blocking" {
  actions    = ["block", "block_session"]
  is_managed = false
}

output "blocking_titles" {
  value = [for p in data.manifold_governance_policies.blocking.policies : p.title]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `actions` (Set of String) Only policies taking these actions.
- `categories` (Set of String) Only policies in these categories.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Only policies that are (or are not) evaluated.
- `framework` (String) Only policies mapping to this taxonomy code, e.g. `OWASP-ASI02`.
- `is_managed` (Boolean) `true` for Manifold-managed policies only, `false` for customer-authored only.
- `query` (String) Case-insensitive substring match on id, title or description.
- `severities` (Set of String) Only policies with these severities.

### Read-Only

- `policies` (Attributes List) Matching policies, most recently updated first. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies))

<a id="nestedatt--policies"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String) What the policy does on a match: `alert`, `advise`, `correct`, `ask`, `block` or `block_session`.
- `action_options` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--policies--action_options))
- `category` (String) One of `ACCESS`, `EXECUTION`, `DATA`, `USAGE`.
- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 creation timestamp.
- `description` (String) What the policy detects and why it matters.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the policy is evaluated at all.
- `id` (String) The policy's identifier, a server-assigned UUID.
- `is_managed` (Boolean) True for a Manifold-maintained policy, which cannot be edited or deleted.
- `owner` (String) Who maintains the policy.
- `priority` (Number) Attribution order when several blocking policies match one event; the highest supplies the block message.
- `response_message` (String) What the agent is told when the policy blocks, or the directive an `advise`/`correct` policy hands the model. Null when unset.
- `severity` (String) Severity carried by the violations this policy produces.
- `taxonomy_mappings` (List of String) Framework codes the policy maps to, e.g. `OWASP-ASI02`.
- `title` (String)
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last change.

<a id="nestedatt--policies--action_options"></a>
### Nested Schema for `policies.action_options`

Read-Only:

- `notify_user` (Boolean) Whether the developer is notified when the policy matches.
